shoes 0.3.2 from crates.io (https://github.com/cfal/shoes), MIT licensed.

Local changes (keep this list exact when upgrading):
- src/embed.rs added: `validate` and `run` entry points for in-process listeners, and
  `run_tun_controlled` (one TUN config on a host-owned packet socket, used by the VM
  network gateway; see the TUN device entry below).
- src/embed.rs: `run_tun_controlled` accepts a host pause barrier, and `HttpRelay`
  exposes the existing HTTP handler for caller-owned TCP sockets and cancellation.
  Embedded listeners and TUN use the IPv4-only resolver policy and reject
  custom DNS groups that could bypass it.
- src/resolver.rs, src/client_proxy_selector.rs, src/tcp/socket_connector_impl.rs
  and src/client_proxy_chain.rs: filter IPv6 and require IPv4 literals at each
  embedded proxy-chain hop.
- src/tun/relay_gate.rs added: pauses packet and relay I/O with a shared barrier
  and invalidates generation-sensitive operations on every suspension.
- src/tun/{mod,tcp_conn,tcp_stack_direct}.rs: track guest and upstream TCP setup,
  retain established TCP through suspension, discard incomplete setup, check
  for shutdown after draining wake notifications, and report unexpected TUN
  thread exit to the embedder.
- src/tun/{packet,udp_handler,udp_manager}.rs: reset UDP sessions on suspension
  and tag queued packets to prevent a rapid resume from reviving old datagrams.
- src/socket_util.rs, src/config/validate.rs: macOS interface binding for IPv4 and
  IPv6 TCP/UDP with if_nametoindex and IP_BOUND_IF/IPV6_BOUND_IF; invalid names,
  unsupported platforms and socket errors are returned without an unbound retry.
- src/tcp/socket_connector_impl.rs: initialize QUIC endpoints on connect, return
  setup errors, and retry failed initialization on subsequent connections; successful
  endpoints are shared by concurrent connections.
- src/embed.rs, src/address.rs, src/dns/{mod,builder,hickory_resolver}.rs:
  opt-in `BoundDns::new(interface, servers)` plus `validate_with_bound_dns`,
  `run_with_bound_dns`, `HttpRelay::new_with_bound_dns` and
  `run_tun_controlled_with_bound_dns`. All selectable first hops must bind the
  same interface; old embedded entry points reject bind_interface without this
  policy. DNS tries supplied IP-literal servers in order over cleartext UDP, with
  a two-second timeout per server and no system resolver or hosts file fallback;
  embedded targets remain IPv4-only.
  Embedded listener mode supports HTTP, SOCKS and mixed over TCP with loopback
  IP-literal bind addresses.
- src/lib.rs: `pub mod embed;`
- Cargo.toml: bin and test targets removed (the library builds as rlib only).
- Removed from the published crate: android/, examples/, scripts/, include/, tests/.
  The unit test that enumerated the upstream examples is removed with its fixtures.
- src/main.rs and the tikv-jemallocator dependency removed (binary only).
- src/embed.rs parses YAML in process. The mobile FFI, socket protector, standalone
  config loaders and FFI logging are removed, along with the Android dependencies.
- src/obfs.rs added: client-side simple-obfs for Shadowsocks (`plugin: obfs`), the
  fake HTTP request / TLS ClientHello written below the Shadowsocks stream.
  Upstream has no plugin support at all.
- src/config/types/client.rs: `ObfsClientConfig`/`ObfsMode`, and
  `ClientProxyConfig::Shadowsocks` gained an optional `plugin` field (the custom
  deserializer/serializer carry it).
- src/tcp/tcp_client_handler_factory.rs: wraps the Shadowsocks handler with
  `ObfsClientHandler` when `plugin` is set.
- src/lib.rs: `mod obfs;` (and the client type re-exports in config/types/mod.rs).
- TUN device (Cabin change, one code path on every platform): the stack reads and
  writes raw IP packets, one datagram each, on a `std::net::UdpSocket` the embedder
  passes in (one half of `embed::loopback_udp_pair`, a connected non-blocking
  loopback UDP pair whose buffers the caller may size through socket2; on Windows it
  also clears SIO_UDP_CONNRESET). Entry points: `embed::run_tun_controlled(config,
  shutdown, gate, device)` and `run_tun_controlled_with_bound_dns(.., bound, device)`.
  The TUN config's `device_fd` is only the schema tag that marks a TUN config; its
  value is ignored. Legacy device fields are accepted for YAML compatibility.
  MTU defaults and packet stack validation are platform-independent.
  * src/tun/wake.rs: `Wake` is a loopback UDP pair, and `WakeReceiver::wait` waits on
    the wake socket and the packet socket with the `polling` crate (level-triggered
    epoll, kqueue or wepoll). `loopback_udp_pair` lives here.
  * src/tun/tcp_stack_direct.rs: one `DirectDevice` and one stack loop over the UDP
    socket. Fd I/O, TUN packet-information headers and EOF detection are removed.
  * src/tun/{mod,tun_server}.rs: one `run_tun_server` taking the device. Real TUN
    device creation, `raw_fd`, `close_fd_on_drop`, `packet_information`, interface
    naming, `start_tun_server` and `run_tun_from_config` are removed, and so is the
    `tun` crate dependency.
  * Tests that used Unix socket pairs use UDP pairs; the EOF-shutdown and
    packet-information tests are removed.
- Cargo.toml: `polling` added, `tun` and the `smoltcp` TUN/TAP feature removed;
  `[target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies] windows-sys` (Foundation, WinSock) is used
  for SIO_UDP_CONNRESET.
- Embedded listener validation rejects non-loopback binds, Unix paths, non-TCP
  transports and other inbound protocols before startup. Removed QUIC, Hysteria2,
  TUIC, TLS, REALITY, AnyTLS and NaiveProxy inbound listeners and the server
  handlers for PortForward, Shadowsocks, Snell, Trojan, VMess and WebSocket.
  ShadowTLS keeps the ServerHello parser used by its client and VLESS Vision.
  REALITY, VLESS, H2Mux and XUDP peer fixtures compile in tests only. The outbound protocol
  implementations, QUIC clients, and the VM TCP/UDP packet stack are retained.
